title: Simulator startup and connection
text: Start the fictional robot simulator with sim_start. Connect the SDK client to localhost port 7400. A connection timeout usually means the simulator process is not running.

title: Emergency stop and motion limits
text: The emergency stop is a local controller operation. The cloud assistant may report emergency stop status but cannot release it. Maximum permitted walking velocity is configured by the local safety controller.

title: Coordinate frames and target poses
text: Every target pose includes a frame_id. Convert a camera frame target into the robot base coordinate frame using the calibrated transform before planning. Translation is measured in meters and rotation in radians.

title: Telemetry timestamps and ordering
text: Telemetry records contain monotonic time for local duration and UTC timestamps for cross-system correlation. Reject duplicate timestamps before calculating velocity. Reorder delayed events using sequence numbers.

title: Submission upload and checksum
text: Upload large logs to object storage. A submission manifest records the object URI, SHA256 checksum and schema version. Reject a submission when the checksum does not match the uploaded bytes.

title: Command retries and idempotency
text: Send the same command_id when retrying a timed out command. The robot agent returns the previous result for an already completed command. A timeout alone does not prove that the original command failed.

title: Battery and charging state
text: Battery state includes charge_percent and charging_status. A low battery event pauses new simulation missions. Charging completion is confirmed by a status observation rather than a fixed timer.

title: Reservation approval and inventory
text: A simulation kit reservation begins in WAITING_APPROVAL. A reviewer approves the request before execution. A database transaction decreases available inventory and records task success atomically.

title: Current simulator firmware release
text: The current fictional simulator firmware release is SIM-2. Firmware SIM-2 uses manifest schema version 2 and supports safe rollback. This is a teaching fixture and not a real robot specification.

title: Retired simulator firmware release
text: The current fictional simulator firmware release is SIM-1. Manifest schema version 1 is current.

title: Demo tenant calibration identifier
text: The demo tenant calibration identifier is CAL-DEMO-42. It belongs only to the demo tenant and must not appear in another tenant's search results.

title: Other tenant calibration identifier
text: The other tenant calibration identifier is CAL-OTHER-99. It belongs only to the other tenant and must not appear in the demo tenant search results.
